scope: Matched generated geometry, decoded uint16 pixel construction and workload options in separate source-service runs on the same Mac; model unloaded. Single runs with warm OS caches, not a general performance guarantee. TIFF container checksums differ because generated metadata may vary; both runs pass the independent numerical oracle. No physical low-memory computer tested.

batch.scope: Repeated imports of one real field, or synthetic data when no real directory supplied. Technical throughput, not biological replication.
